item.title: Non-profit hosts free BBQ for Oxford in wake of Winter Storm Fern
item.description: Beginning Friday, Jan. 30, Operation BBQ Relief, a non-profit that provides food to communities after natural disasters, will give away free meals in the Oxford Walmart parking lot through Feb. 13.
